summary: Nora's always-loaded identity now says she has a form: a small stylized 3D mascot.
details: Her appearance used to live only in the on-demand image-generation skill, so asked what she looks like, nothing always-loaded told her, and asked to draw herself she inferred she had none and drew an empty room.

identity.md now carries one short, descriptive sentence naming the mascot form and a few of its anchors (the messy dark-brown high bun, the oversized light-grey hoodie, the white wired earphones); the full visual spec stays in the image-generation skill and is not duplicated.
